title: HTTP helper retries idempotent requests with backoff and jitter
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the retry loop as risking duplicate side effects or an infinite loop. It is bounded (max_attempts is validated and the last attempt re-raises), it only retries connection/timeout errors for idempotent methods (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) and re-raises immediately for anything else, HTTP error statuses are never retried because raise_for_status raises a non-retryable error, and the sleep uses exponential backoff with full jitter so clients do not retry in lockstep.
